verdict.rationale: Cursor documents real outbound webhooks. When you create a cloud agent with a webhook URL, Cursor sends HMAC-SHA256-signed HTTP POST status-change notifications, with documented headers, payload and verification snippets. The limits are significant: webhooks exist only on the legacy v0 API (the v1 page says "Webhooks are coming soon"), they cover only statusChange on ERROR/FINISHED, and they are set per agent rather than as a general event subscription. Automations' incoming-webhook triggers are inbound, not outbound subscriptions, and earn no credit. Missing for 10: webhook support in the current v1 API, a broader event catalog beyond agent status changes, team-level webhook registration/management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
